pre_build_gates: Acquire the exact source archives in the Builder source directory only after Builder's active GCC test is terminal.

For the xrdp and xorgxrdp uploaded release archives, verify the acquired bytes against the GitHub REST asset digests recorded here; record a local SHA-256 as well. For the PipeWire module tag archive, calculate and record SHA-256 locally because GitHub publishes no uploaded archive digest.
Verify the release tag signatures against independently trusted maintainer keys; GitHub's expired-key verified badge alone is insufficient.
Verify the configured Xorg Server 21.1.18 source and its libxcvt, Pixman, and font-util build dependencies in the actual Builder/rootfs before starting the dependency-ordered build.
evidence_limit: Tag target commits and upstream-published release asset digests are recorded, but no archive bytes were acquired or locally hashed in this audit. The GitHub REST digests are publisher metadata, not independent measurements. Signature/key trust, Builder dependency availability, successful build/install, RDP audio routing, physical audio, and M06 completion remain unproven.
